headline: Corteva expands margins on lower sales, raises outlook
summary_short: Corteva's Q2 net sales fell 1% y/y to $6,379M as Crop Protection pricing pressure in Latin America offset Seed gains, while GAAP EPS of $1.73 was down from $1.92 a year ago even as Operating EBITDA (non-GAAP) rose 4% on more than 190 basis points of margin expansion.
summary_long: Net sales of $6,379M fell 1% y/y (organic -2%) on a 3% volume decline, mostly timing shifts in North America/Latin America, partly offset by 1% price/mix gains. Seed net sales were flat as price/mix (+3%, led by licensing income) offset a 3% volume drop; segment EBITDA rose 6%. Crop Protection net sales fell 4% (organic -6%) on a 4% Latin America price decline; segment EBITDA still rose 2% on cost/productivity actions. GAAP net income from continuing operations fell to $1.22B from $1.38B; consolidated net income of $1,161M was down 11.6% y/y. Cash rose to $2,365M (+14.5% y/y). Corteva raised FY2026 guidance to Operating EBITDA $4.1-4.3B and Operating EPS $3.60-3.80; separation remains on track for October 1, 2026.
